visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a street-level view of the 'Beara Beara' storefront in London, featuring a vibrant blue facade and gold-lettered signage. A woman wearing a white long-sleeved crop top and a white tiered ruffled skirt walks towards the camera and enters the shop. (2) Inside the store, the camera pans across extensive wooden shelving units displaying a wide variety of leather bags in various shades of brown, black, and maroon. The woman is seen picking up a dark brown backpack, turning it over in her hands to examine the leather. (3) The scene transitions to the woman outdoors on a cobblestone street, now wearing a brown suede jacket, dark skirt, and a green beret, modeling a black crossbody bag. This is followed by a series of archival photos of Taylor Swift wearing Beara Beara products. (4) Back inside the store, the woman demonstrates the features of a large satchel, highlighting the iconic red plaid lining and the smooth operation of the metal clasps. She places an iPhone Pro Max into a small black structured bag to prove its surprisingly large capacity. (5) The final sequence shows the woman holding multiple bags simultaneously while energetic promotional text overlays appear on the screen, detailing Black Friday dates and a specific discount code. She continues to smile and gesture toward the product displays until the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy female voice speaking in Mandarin, accompanied by an upbeat acoustic-pop BGM featuring a prominent guitar and light percussion. The speaker's tone is extremely friendly and high-pitched. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound effect triggers as the speaker highlights a bag's closure. The BGM remains steady in the background. The vocal delivery is rapid, with very short pauses between sentences. (3) A distinct 'ding' or bubble pop sound effect occurs alongside a visual shift to celebrity photos. The speaker's arousal level rises as she expresses surprise. Some subtle leather-handling rustles can be detected under the music. (4) The speaker transitions into a more descriptive, informative tone while demonstrating the satchel's interior. A crisp latching sound is heard when the bag is closed. The music maintains its driving rhythm. (5) As the call to action begins, the female voice becomes even more animated, emphasizing the discount code. The BGM maintains its tempo until the very end, concluding with a final happy exclamation from the narrator.
